descriptions.rgb: The camera wearer is beside and above a bed, looking downward at a small white-and-gray cat on the mattress roughly 0.4–0.8 m in front of the camera; a wall or headboard lies beyond the bed, and a bright sunlit patch crosses the left/central mattress. A small blue cup-like object appears on the mattress to the cat’s right in the middle frames, about 0.2–0.4 m from the cat and roughly 0.5–0.8 m from the camera wearer, then moves toward or beyond the right edge as the viewpoint changes. Parts of the cat, the wearer’s arm, the blue object, and a pale object at the far right are cut off by frame edges at different times, and no other person is visible beyond the camera wearer’s arm and hand.
